ODIBO PDF — unsigned Windows x64 engineering test build

M4.0 offers a per-user Setup and an independent Portable ZIP. Check the candidate
PR for actual CI results and owner acceptance; this notice is not test evidence.
For Portable, extract the whole inner ZIP to a new writable folder and run odibo-pdf.exe.
The CLI is odibo-pdf-cli.exe. Keep models/, licences/, THIRD_PARTY_CARGO.html,
LICENSE-MIT, LICENSE-APACHE, NOTICE and attribution files with the executables.
portable.txt keeps settings, logs, recovery and new digital IDs in ODIBOPDFData.
Without that marker, including the installed copy, ODIBO uses its existing per-user
directories; PdfCraft data is not migrated. Keep the marker for portable isolation.
Windows may still maintain its own caches or metadata.

Setup is intended for the current user without administrator rights, under
%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\ODIBO PDF. It must preserve user documents and application data
on update/uninstall. Save and close documents before setup. Uninstall through Windows
Settings > Apps. No automatic app launch, MCP server, service or autostart is enabled.

No automatic update service or official release is configured. Setup and application
are unsigned; do not describe them as publisher-verified. Do not disable Defender or
SmartScreen. If blocked or verification fails, stop and report the result voluntarily.
Do not use irreplaceable originals for testing. Updates require your explicit action.

Code retains MIT OR Apache-2.0 and upstream copyright notices. ODIBO graphics have
separate terms in licences/assets/odibo/LICENSE-ODIBO-BRAND.txt. Fonts, components
and OCR models retain their own licences. No exclusive AI copyright is claimed.

BUILD_INFO.txt records the source commit. SHA256SUMS.txt covers the package files.
The outer beta artifact also includes package checksums and BUILD_MANIFEST.json.
A matching SHA-256 checks integrity, not independent publisher authenticity.
The GitHub Actions artifact ZIP requires GitHub sign-in and expires after seven days.
See the repository's docs/ODIBO_WINDOWS_INSTALLATION.md and
docs/ODIBO_WINDOWS_UPDATES.md for instructions; no personal PDFs or raw logs are requested.
